stages.label: Intake
stages.instructions: Clarify audience, purpose, length, tone, required content and context. Identify each supplied source versus reference, preserve originals and record provenance, properties and resource choices.

stages.label: Source understanding
stages.instructions: Review the source before proposing cuts. Document its argument, demonstrations, emotional beats, intended conclusion, technical properties and uncertainties in source-understanding.md. Record a content map with source-bound segments, transcript anchors and known timing limitations in content-map.json. Do not invent observations or unknown word timings.

stages.label: Editorial strategy
stages.instructions: Write work/edit-plan.md describing the editorial strategy, retained meaning, specific cuts, timing, selective graphics/audio treatment and representative preview. Explain every intervention against the brief and source findings.

stages.label: Edit
stages.instructions: Execute the reviewed plan through the production quality action coordinator. Preserve source media and successful revisions, inspect each result, recalculate actual timeline mappings and address revision-bound feedback. Record real artifact paths and technical findings; rendering alone is not acceptance.

stages.label: Final review
stages.instructions: Register actual delivery files, review all current production rules, complete audiovisual and technical checks, preserve pending findings and obtain a current production-quality completion receipt. Confirm exact deliverable hashes. QA completion never authorizes publication.
